messages:
Sophia: Quick async pulse for the quarter — 5 min status please: what shipped this sprint, what slipped, who owns next remediation steps. Tag owners. :clock1:

Liam: Runtime v2 low-latency path shipped to canary yesterday. Perf numbers look good on p50/p95. Still need docs update. I can take doc PR.

Priya: Platform rollout for multi-tenant routing slipped — we hit an edge case in routing table reconciliation. Root cause is config race in rollout job.

Sophia: @Priya thanks. Who's on the fix and ETA?

Priya: @Sophia @Carlos and I paired this morning. Carlos owns the hotfix in the reconciliation worker, I own the rollout policy test. ETA EOD Wednesday for hotfix canary.

Carlos: Confirming — I have a small patch, tests added. Will push to staging today, canary tomorrow. Expect ~2h downtime-free rollout.

Ava: Embedding pipeline improvements shipped (quantized flow + caching). Observability shows 18% cost reduction.

Jamal: Small heads-up — embedding downstream consumer (search-service) needs schema bump for new vector dims. I've opened CR-422 to add compatibility layer. Owner: Jamal.

Sophia: Noted. Can we get a migration plan? simple backfill or dual-read?

Jamal: Dual-read for 2 weeks, then backfill via batch job. I'll post schedule by EOD.

Priya: For the slipped routing work, blocking dep is infra permissions for the canary namespace. @deploy-bot can you confirm current permission state?

deploy-bot: Permission audit: canary-namespace missing service-account-role for reconciliation-worker since 2026-03-05. Suggested action: reapply role binding.

Carlos: I can reapply once I get approval from infra (security). CC @Ava for compliance sign-off.

Ava: Approving role reapply for canary. Please paste the exact kubectl command you plan to run.

Carlos: Will run: ```kubectl apply -f canary-reconcile-rb.yaml``` contents minimal: `kind: RoleBinding` `subjects: - reconciler-sa`

Sophia: Great. Small follow-ups: 1) list owners+next steps in the OKR doc (prod board) by EOD tomorrow 2) any CRs blocked waiting review?

Liam: I've got two small doc CRs (runtime README + perf playbook). Pinged @Priya for review.

Priya: Reviewing now, will approve today.

Sophia: Thanks all. If anything slips beyond Wed, call it out here and include rollback plan. Otherwise I'll fold these notes into the weekly OKR snapshot. :white_check_mark:
